name: Shrug (Band)
instructions: Stand on a band, holding the ends at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Squeeze hard at the top for a full second.
Lower slowly. The band keeps tension on the traps throughout.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: Shrug (Band) is a beginner pulling exercise for the upper back, performed with minimal equipment. Pulling balances all the pressing we do in life and keeps the upper back and posture strong.
